checkpoint_test: persist then SHA-validate/reload and compare predictions using rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-12
metric: original H2 and original conjunctive H1 on the 8 diagnostic validation geometries; diagnostic only, never admission

models.selection: frozen validation early stop; patience=50, min_delta=1e-05

prediction_order: case ID join; wavelengths 440-460 nm ascending; m=-3..3; TE/TM
preprocessing: fit GeometryStandardizer and V2TargetNormalizer on 24 training geometries only
selection_rule: choose middle numeric entry of each frozen candidate grid; MLP seed fixed to lowest frozen seed; no response-based choice or search
target: packed 609 values: 588 Cartesian C_hat channels + 21 log(P_scale); strictly positive finite P_scale only; no epsilon/clipping
